strip.label: one strip and a corner fold
strip.observed: A strip fold followed by a diagonal sends only cells inside the flap across the diagonal.
strip.construct: Vary the legal crease and punch sites. Keep a finite flap and actually occupied punch. Derive the unfolded holes per ring, then omit or displace one band for the closest foil. To require the diagonal, choose an off-crease site with a distinct reflected partner.

parallel.label: two parallel strips and a corner fold
parallel.observed: Parallel folds can bring different original bands onto the same surviving strip.

crossed.label: two crossed strips and a corner fold
crossed.observed: Perpendicular folds bring row and column preimages together before the final corner turn.
